Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning hunting-related enforcement actions involving tribal members.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to hunting-related enforcement actions involvingtribal members; and adding a new section to chapter 77.15 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Upon presentation of a tribal identification card by a memberof a federally recognized tribe to a fish and wildlife officer or exofficio fish and wildlife officer, the officer must immediately referany inspection, investigation, or other enforcement action related tothe hunting activity of the tribal member to the enforcement authorityof the tribe, if the activity occurred on any open and unclaimed landswhere the tribe has a treaty or other federally recognized right tohunt. (2) The requirements under subsection (1) of this section do notabrogate or otherwise affect the terms of any intergovernmental, mutuallaw enforcement assistance, or other cooperative agreement entered intoby the member's tribe and the department or local law enforcementagency. p. 1 SHB 1496 (3) To maximize efficiency and mutual benefit in huntingenforcement, cooperative management and mutual law enforcementassistance agreements agreed to by tribes and the department or locallaw enforcement agency are hereby considered legally binding, andencouraged, on open and unclaimed lands where a tribe has a treaty orother federally recognized right to hunt.
